name: iRedMail
tagline: Full-featured mail server. Shell installer, postfix + dovecot + spamassassin.
shortDescription: iRedMail is a full-featured mail server with a shell installer. Postfix, Dovecot, SpamAssassin, ClamAV, Amavis, Roundcube/SOGo webmail. Supports OpenLDAP, MySQL, Postgres backends.
longDescription:
## What it is

iRedMail is a full-featured mail server with a shell-based installer. Postfix, Dovecot, SpamAssassin, ClamAV, Amavis, Roundcube or SOGo webmail, full DKIM/SPF/DMARC, supports OpenLDAP, MySQL, MariaDB, and PostgreSQL backends.

## Why we recommend it

If you want a Linux mail server (not Docker) with maximum control and a battle-tested installer, iRedMail is the answer. The shell installer sets up everything on RHEL/CentOS/Rocky or Debian/Ubuntu.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted mail on bare metal or a VM
- Companies that prefer non-Docker deployments
- OpenLDAP-backed mail for an organization
- When you want a single shell installer to set everything up
installCommand: curl -O https://dl.iredmail.org/yum/iRedMail-1.7.0.tar.bz2 && tar xjf iRedMail-1.7.0.tar.bz2 && cd iRedMail-1.7.0 && bash iRedMail.sh
installInstructions:
**RHEL/CentOS/Rocky:**
```
curl -O https://dl.iredmail.org/yum/iRedMail-1.7.0.tar.bz2
tar xjf iRedMail-1.7.0.tar.bz2
cd iRedMail-1.7.0
bash iRedMail.sh
```

**Debian/Ubuntu:** Same script, just download the .tar.bz2 from the Ubuntu tab on iredmail.org.
pricingDetails: Free. Apache-2.0 licensed. Self-host on RHEL/Debian.
